artworks.title: A Hand Holding Empty Gloves
artworks.medium: red chalk on beige oatmeal paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of a person's hands. Both hands are depicted in a close-up view, with the left hand appearing to hold or support something, while the right hand is relaxed and open. The drawing is done in red chalk on beige paper, showing shading and texture. The paper has slightly uneven edges. The drawing does not include any background context or additional objects, concentrating solely on the hands.

artworks.title: Henry, Duke of Lorrain
artworks.medium: gouache on parchment, mounted to wood
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mrs. Robert M. Weidenhammer
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a man in a frontal position. He has a full mustache and beard, fair skin, light-colored eyes, and light hair styled back. He is wearing a high-collared garment, possibly a coat with a broad black collar. Surrounding him is a decorative frame with intricate floral and scroll designs. Below the image, the text reads "HENRY DVC DE LORRAINE." The background within the frame is a red and pink pattern resembling marble or clouds, while the outside of the portrait is set against a darker and ornamental border.

artworks.title: Three Oriental Heads
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Leger Galleries Ltd.
artworks.description: The image is a circular sketch showing two individuals in profile, focusing on their head and shoulders. One person is in front of the other, appearing to look upward. Both individuals have roughly outlined facial features and hair. Their clothing is suggested with simple lines, and neither is wearing jewelry or holding objects. The background is blank, and the image is monochromatic with no added color or shading, emphasizing line and simplicity.

artworks.title: Three Oriental Heads
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Leger Galleries Ltd.
artworks.description: The image is a circular sketch featuring three figures shown from the shoulders up. The person on the left appears in profile, looking out to the left with distinct facial features, their hair pulled back under a stylized headdress with feather details. The central figure is slightly turned to the side, wearing an elaborate helmet adorned with a plume and intricate designs. The third person, also wearing a helmet, is obscured and facing right. The figures are dressed in drapery, and there is no background detail in the sketch.

artworks.title: Three Oriental Heads
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Leger Galleries Ltd.
artworks.description: The image is a circular sketch featuring three figures showing their upper bodies. The figure on the left has a profile view with curly hair. The central figure wears a helmet, partially obscuring their features. The third figure faces slightly to the left, with facial features partially obscured by shading and straight, medium-length hair. The clothing is depicted with simple lines indicating robes or drapery around their shoulders. There are no visible objects or jewelry. The background is minimal, drawing attention to the three main figures.

artworks.title: Two Oriental Heads
artworks.medium: pen and black ink on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of The Leger Galleries Ltd.
artworks.description: The image depicts a circular drawing of two male figures in profile. Both men are facing left, with one figure wearing a turban adorned with a tall center piece and intricate patterns. The other figure has a less elaborate turban and obscured facial features. Both men have mustaches and detailed clothing. The background shows linear shading and hints of an indoor setting.

artworks.title: Nude with Her Hands Raised
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Harry A. Brooks
artworks.description: The image is a line drawing of a person in motion. The person is depicted in a dynamic pose, with one leg slightly bent and the other extended, both arms raised, and hands open with fingers splayed. The face has minimal features, with a prominent nose and a calm expression, and the hair is represented by simple lines in a wave-like shape. The person is drawn nude, emphasizing the body's form with bold, continuous lines. There are no visible accessories, and the background is plain. The artist's signature, "Grosz," is seen in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: The Heart of the Andes
artworks.artist: William Forrest, after Frederic Edwin Church
artworks.medium: engraving in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of A. Thompson Ellwanger III

artworks.title: Four Evangelists in a Scriptorium
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene with multiple animals and ornate architectural features. The composition presents an architectural setting, likely of a grand hall or library, characterized by high archways, detailed columns, and decorative ceilings with wooden beams. The setting includes intricately designed windows which illuminate the interior subtly. Within this space, seated figures are engaged in activities such as reading or writing on large lecterns. Among the architectural elements, various animals are present, including a cow and a rooster. This artwork's style bears resemblance to the works of Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: Christ on the Cross
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a drawing of a man shown from head to toe, positioned on a cross. He is hanging with arms extended horizontally and legs together. His facial features are outlined with a pronounced emaciated look, and his head is slightly tilted to one side. The man has shoulder-length hair, which appears wavy and is depicted loosely around his face. His body is shown wearing only a cloth draped around his waist. The background is plain, featuring a textured appearance. The drawing is bordered by a simple frame with a pale color.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome in a Cave
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a figure seated in a natural, rocky environment. The scene shows a person engrossed in writing or drawing on a tablet or book, surrounded by a dense landscape with trees, rocks, and clouds. In the background, there is a view of a lake or river with a boat, and a distant town with church spires. A lion is partially visible among the rocks and trees. The drawing is detailed with intricate lines creating textures for the foliage, fabric, and overall composition. The style resembles that of Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: A Boy Wearing a Military Cap
artworks.medium: black chalk heightened with white on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows the head of a person facing the viewer directly. The facial features include a round face, rounded cheeks, a defined nose, and a neutral expression on their lips. The person's eyes are open and gazing directly forward. They wear a cap slightly slouched to the side, with hair peeking out showing gentle waves or curls. The individual has on a garment with a loose-fitting collar tied in the front with a bow. The background is a plain, textured paper. No jewelry or additional objects are visible.

artworks.title: A Young Man Embracing a Girl
artworks.medium: charcoal on blue paper (now faded) heightened with white chalk
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Katherine and Alexandra Baer in Memory of their father, Dr. George Baer

artworks.title: Norwegian Coast During a Storm
artworks.medium: etching with bitten tone on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with detailed line work and etching. The view is from the shoreline, capturing turbulent seas crashing against cliffs on the left. The horizon is low, with swirling clouds in the sky. In the distance to the right, a rocky formation is visible in the water. The etching technique depicts the texture of the sea and cliffs with dense strokes. The monochromatic palette of blacks and grays intensifies the contrast between the sea and the sky.

artworks.title: Plan and Three Views of a Circular Church
artworks.medium: pen and black and gray ink with gray, pink, and blue washes on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural plans for a grand structure. It includes frontal and cross-sectional elevations, an interior perspective view, and a floor plan at the bottom. The elevations show a building with classic architectural elements such as domes, columns, and intricate detailing. The perspective view displays an elaborate interior space with high vaulted ceilings and ornate detailing. The floor plan at the bottom provides a layout indicating various sections and rooms of the structure with annotations in a handwritten script. The drawing uses ink and possibly watercolors to highlight different parts of the plan.

artworks.title: Three Views and a Plan of a Triangular Parish Church
artworks.medium: pen and black and gray ink with gray, pink, and blue washes on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of architectural elements and design plans of a church. The image features multiple detailed architectural sketches, including an interior perspective, cross-section view, elevation, and floor plan of a grand church or cathedral. The drawing on the upper left shows an opulent interior with high ceilings, intricate frescoes, and large windows. Below this is a cross-sectional view of a dome, revealing structural details. The lower right of the image features an elevation sketch of the church exterior, showcasing a baroque facade with a central dome flanked by towers. The upper right includes a floor plan, detailing the layout and arrangement of the building's interior spaces. The detailed line work and annotations suggest a draft or study intended for architectural study or instruction.

artworks.title: Interior of a Temple
artworks.medium: pen and black and gray ink with gray wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an elaborate architectural interior. The image depicts a grandiose space with high ceilings, ornate classical columns, and detailed stone carvings. The focal point is a large arch that frames a fountain or sculpture centerpiece, featuring a figure surrounded by decorative motifs. The drawing emphasizes perspective, guiding the viewer's eye through the arches and columns, providing a sense of depth. Architectural details such as the intricate moldings, the rounded symmetry of the upper windows, and the ornate capitals on the columns contribute to a Renaissance or neoclassical aesthetic. The drawing showcases a mastery of form and line, capturing the grandeur and complexity of the architecture with precision and artistic flair.

artworks.title: Plan for a Decorated Ceiling
artworks.medium: pen and black and gray ink with gray and black wash on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural floor plan. It shows a complex layout with symmetrical and geometric design elements arranged in a grid-like pattern. Dark areas represent walls or structural elements, while lighter areas correspond to open spaces or decorative zones. The plan includes circular motifs, rectangles, and intricate patterns, suggesting a classical or Baroque influence. The design features complex interlocking spaces, possibly for a large public building or palace.

artworks.title: Moonlit Night (Mondnacht): pl. 4
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint
artworks.description: The landscape features two figures near rocky outcrops and vegetation. In the distance, a river flows down rocks, creating small waterfalls in a lush terrain with trees. The horizon is dominated by cliffs and mountain peaks. The painting has detailed brushstrokes depicting texture and movement of water. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of gray to convey depth and contrast.

artworks.title: Bear and Elf (Bär und Elfe): pl.1
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an animal lounging in a tree and a figure in another tree. The scene depicts a bear sitting comfortably on a tree branch, surrounded by foliage and trees. Above the bear, a figure is perched on another branch, gazing downward. The composition captures a serene natural setting, with intricate linework to define the trees, leaves, and the textures of the bear's fur. The sky is depicted in the background with soft shades suggesting a landscape in the distance. The artwork's attention to detail in rendering the leaves, branches, and characters contributes to the tranquil mood of the drawing, creating a harmonious interaction between nature and the figure.

artworks.title: Page from the Collection of Niccolò Gaddi (So-Called "Vasari Page")
artworks.artist: Florentine 16th century, The "Chief Framer", Raffaellino del Garbo, and Sandro Botticelli, and Filippino Lippi
artworks.medium: album page with ten drawings on recto and verso in various media with decoration in pen and brown ink, brown and gray wash, on light buff paper
artworks.description: Four drawings of faces and bodies are affixed onto a larger vertical album page, on which architectural decorations have been drawn on to act as frames. Three vertical drawings are spaced along the top half of the ivory-colored album page, and one larger horizontal drawing fills the bottom half. Drawn with brown ink and gray washes, the frames resemble moldings and scrolls around each drawing, with garlands flanking the bottom sketch. The three drawings in the top zone are done with metalpoint on gray or mauve paper and are highlighted with touches of white. The metalpoint technique creates faint silvery-gray lines. In the top left drawing, a nude man stands facing us. In the center, the face of a cleanshaven young man with curling hair beneath a cap looks down and to our left. Below the face, a forearm and hand clutching a rock appears next to another study of a hand. In the drawing to our right, a man wearing a toga-like robe leans on a walking stick, facing our left in profile. The drawing at the bottom is done with gray metalpoint lines and white strokes against golden yellow paper. A person sits and twists up in a spiral to our left. In the center of this drawing are three studies of muscular legs. Then, to our right, a man sits on a throne holding a spear or scepter and globe, facing our right in profile. An inscription in the frame below the bottom drawing reads, “Filippo Lippi Pitt: Fior:”

artworks.title: Head of a Youth Wearing a Cap; a Right Forearm with the Hand Clutching a Stone; and a Left Hand Holding a Drapery
artworks.medium: metalpoint heightened with white gouache on mauve prepared paper
artworks.description: This print shows the face of a person above two disembodied arms. The person visible at the top has a straight nose, high cheekbones, and long, curly hair flowing around their face, adorned with a thin cap. They are looking downward and to the right. Below their face, one arm is bent and extended, the hand clenched around an indistinct object. The other hand is near the bottom-right corner and also seems to be holding something faint. The background is a pale pink color, and the lines of the print are faint gray with some white highlights.

artworks.title: Standing Nude Youth
artworks.medium: metalpoint heightened with white on gray-prepared paper
artworks.description: This is a faint drawing of a person within an octagonal frame. The sketch portrays a nude male figure with soft facial features and curly hair. The man stands with one arm slightly extended and the other hand resting near his thigh, and his face is turned to the right. The background is gray, with the figure drawn in lines only slightly darker. Around the image, a frame has been drawn in brown lines on a white background.

artworks.title: Man with a Stick
artworks.medium: metalpoint heightened with white on gray-prepared paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man in profile view walking while slightly hunched over, holding a staff. He has a bearded and aged appearance with wavy hair. He is depicted wearing loose-fitting clothing, possibly a robe or toga. The background has a textured surface with a decorative framework outlining the central figure, featuring curved and circular line designs.
